column4: '1281130838']	Nexperia China eyes new wafer suppliers in 6 months amid legal fight with Dutch chipmaker	"Nexperia China
column5: the estranged unit of the Dutch chipmaker
column6: is pushing forward with efforts to secure new wafer suppliers in six months
column7: as the firm’s Netherlands head office and mainland Chinese owner Wingtech Technology started direct talks last week.

column1: In its shareholders meeting in Shanghai on Friday
column2: Wingtech said Nexperia China’s plant in Dongguan
column4: continued to operate amid “a significant gap in wafer supply”
column5: reports from several state-backed media said.

column1: Nexperia’s head office in Nijmegen had suspended further supply of wafers to the Dongguan facility on October 29
column2: following Nexperia China’s refusal of payments for these wafers. According to Wingtech
column3: the Dutch head office “had restricted fund disbursements to Nexperia China”.

column1: That prompted Nexperia China to start the process of validating domestic wafer suppliers
column2: which “is expected to be completed between the first and second quarters of 2026”
Wingtech claimed that Nexperia China managed to produce and deliver more than 11 billion chips since mid-October to more than 800 clients globally.

column1: That represented a 14 per cent drop in production
column2: compared with Nexperia’s annual global output
column3: which exceeded 110 billion units before the dispute with the Dutch head office. The Dongguan facility accounted for 70 per cent of the chipmaker’s total output."	2025-12-27 14:25:25+08:00	Success
